primarySources: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (2026 inflation adjustments); IRS IR-2025-103
Form 1040 instructions — Social Security Benefits Worksheet & Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet
meta.note: Values transcribed from authoritative sources. The independent oracle (tools/oracle.py) carries the same constants; the engine must never import the oracle — the fixtures are the cross-check.

additionalStandardDeduction65.note: IRC 63(f) age-65 add-on, PER qualifying person. Distinct from the OBBBA senior bonus deduction.

ordinaryBrackets.note: Each entry is the inclusive top of the band and its marginal rate; final band upTo=null is the top rate.

preferentialRateThresholds.note: Taxable-income tops of the 0% and 15% long-term capital gain / qualified dividend bands.

socialSecurityTaxability.note: IRC 86 base amounts are UNINDEXED (fixed since 1983/1993). base2 threshold = base1 + base2Additional.

niit.note: 3.8% on the LESSER of net investment income or (MAGI_NIIT - threshold). Thresholds UNINDEXED. A Roth conversion is NOT net investment income.

seniorBonusDeduction.note: OBBBA temporary deduction, tax years 2025-2028 ONLY. $6,000 PER qualifying individual age 65+. Phaseout is 6% PER qualifying individual (so MFJ with both 65+ phases at 12% combined). Computed once on Schedule 1-A line 35 and entered on BOTH 36a and 36b. Taken BELOW the line — reduces taxable income only, NOT AGI or any MAGI.

openDecision.description: Schedule 1-A whole-dollar rounding convention for the line-35 per-person phaseout is a form-instruction question. Fixtures currently carry UNROUNDED cents (e.g. SD-03 = 11999.88). Resolve against the Schedule 1-A instructions before Phase 2 ships; record the choice here and regenerate affected fixtures.

applicableAge.note: SECURE 2.0 sec. 107. The 1959 statutory drafting glitch was resolved to age 73 by Treasury in the July 2024 final regulations.

uniformLifetimeTable.note: Treas. Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-9(c), 2022 final regulations. Distribution period by age at year end.

firstDollarsOutRule.note: The RMD is deemed distributed first and is NOT eligible for Roth conversion (Treas. Reg. 1.408A-4, Q&A-6). Amounts contributed to a Roth anyway are treated as a REGULAR contribution and are an excess contribution (6% IRC 4973 excise) only to the extent they exceed the allowable regular Roth contribution.

qcdLimit.note: Per person age 70.5+. Present in the current app.

charitable2026.note: Not exercised by Phase 0 fixtures. 0.5% AGI floor for itemizers (Pub 505, 2026); 35% benefit cap in the 37% bracket; $1,000/$2,000 (S/MFJ) above-the-line for non-itemizers. Flagged for re-verification before it drives any calculation.
